create_coco_api_wrapper: create a COCO instance from an annotation JSON file to query image and category data
get_ann_ids_coco: get annotation IDs filtered by image IDs, category IDs, area range, and iscrowd flag
load_anns_coco: load annotation objects by their integer IDs from the COCO dataset
create_cocopanoptic_index: create an index for panoptic segmentation annotations mapping segment IDs to annotations
load_anns_cocopanoptic: load panoptic segmentation annotations by segment ID from the COCOPanoptic dataset
